capabilities: render Code Hike components in previews
trigger previews via an mdx: preview command
extras: The README recommends turning on open source mode; it is very short and points to a copyable Code Hike example rather than explaining features in detail.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown but not MDX, so notes using MDX/JSX syntax cannot be previewed in the app.

relations.evidence: This plugin also provides added support for Code Hike.

summary: MDX previewer that renders MDX syntax in Obsidian, with added support for Code Hike code presentations.
